description: 3 positives (1 de) + 2 near-misses + 1 counterexample. Positives are the three things this skill resolves: who should review, what the PR description should say about risk, and which historical bug patterns the touched paths match. The near-misses are the two surfaces one step either side — performing the review itself, and opening the PR — both of which name reviewers and PRs without asking who should be routed where. The counterexample guards the bare word 'review' outside code.

queries.q: who should review this PR? it touches the billing and tenant paths
write the risk section of the PR description for these changed files
wer sollte sich diesen Branch ansehen, und wie riskant ist er?
review this diff and tell me what is wrong with it
open the pull request against main
review our vendor contract before we sign it
